answeredQuestions: What can be deleted, merged or collapsed across runtime/scripts/frontier-admit.cjs, both reduce-state.cjs reducers, runtime/scripts/convergence.cjs, runtime/scripts/fanout-run.cjs and the two workflow YAMLs while every promise stays kept?
ruledOut: Collapsing the two reducers into one file

label: dispatch-iteration.cjs hand-builds claude and codex while four other kinds use buildLineageCommand; routing the two through the shared builder deletes about 300 lines and closes the acceptEdits drift.

Six of the eight executor branches in each YAML are the same command with a different --executor value, and their notes restate EXECUTOR_KIND_FLAG_SUPPORT; one if_cli branch plus the two special cases deletes about 100 lines per YAML.
The research YAML writes step_frontier_seed twice, the fan-out preview command twice, and two pre-spawn refusal guards in the same shape; collapsing them removes about 50 lines.

The frontier marker regex and the frontier dashboard renderer are implemented twice in different trees, and the review copy already has the visits field and active-node line the research copy lacks; one shared frontier-projection module removes both copies.

The Flash effort pin is mirrored in fanout-run.cjs and executor-config.ts, and native is a fan-out adapter that cannot start on OpenCode v2; importing the pin and removing native deletes about 45 lines and one version-dependent path.
